.19 jihvāgram जिह्वाग्रम्
Tip of the tongue

.20 jihvātalam जिह्वातलम्
Surface of the tongue

.21 jihvā-mūlam, jihvāprabandhaḥ, jihvābandhanam, rasanabandhanam जिह्वामूलम्, जिह्वाप्रबन्धः, जिह्वाबन्धनम्, रसनबन्धनम्
Root of the tongue

jihvāmūlagatamalaḥ जिह्वामूलगतमलः
Debris deposition at the root of the tongue
A disorder characterized by restricted expiration; bad mouth smell/halitosis.

.22 jihvā-sevanī जिह्वासेवनी
Frenulum of the tongue

.36 jihvāstambhaḥ जिह्वास्तम्भः
Rigid tongue
A disorder characterized by inability to eat food and liquids; inability to speak.
